requested.order: Each round follows the previous round's fix and focused verification; library rounds follow product rounds and synchronization.

invariants: Preserve business behavior, complete datasets, UI layout and user interactions.
Do not fabricate findings to meet a per-round quota.

rounds.scope: Core loading, initialization, wake listeners and ownership
rounds.finding: History disabled still loaded Group on challenge start or login during a run, with no consumer.
rounds.fix: Gate challenge wake on history setting; disabling removes the wake listener; enabling during an active run ensures Group and restores the run.

rounds.scope: Search, result, application and listing state ownership
rounds.finding: Result metadata updated while copied application title/leader/class stayed stale; cross-category or hidden active applications dropped result events.
rounds.fix: Centralized application result adoption; full result batches notify once; coalesced single-ID updates include active applications outside the browse store, survive browse reset and expire their listener with the last active application. Application status, ordering and automatic-join state are untouched.

coverage: other-category update combined with bulk event

rounds.scope: Notes identity, storage, transfer, asynchronous inspection and editor ownership
rounds.finding: Editing a draft during inspection kept the old save callback valid, which wrote old identity/reason and replaced the user's newer input.
rounds.fix: All editable save fields invalidate and cancel a pending save before changing its draft, preserve input and clear the stale waiting status; the next explicit Save uses current data.

rounds.scope: Host, modal and native-field lifecycles; keyboard ownership during window transitions
rounds.finding: Host retained outgoing pages for the close animation while Settings key capture and Find shortcuts still performed bindings/applications.
rounds.fix: Cancel Settings capture at close start and suspend Find keyboard shortcuts during hiding; retain outgoing page and animation, and restore normal input on reopen.

coverage: no Enter applications or Shift-F10 menu while closing
shortcuts and capture work after rapid reopen

rounds.scope: Cross-package window entry contracts, settings propagation, display profiles and package metadata
rounds.finding: Bindings, minimap and slash duplicated a physical-visibility check that discarded a second toggle during the close animation.
rounds.fix: Route all three entries through Core ToggleWindow; use the existing Host hiding state to reopen through the normal business loader without changing IsShown semantics.

rounds.scope: Group search/result/application batch reads, notifications and consumers
rounds.finding: Single-result bursts coalesced native reads by ID but emitted one applications notification per active ID, repeating view rebuilds.
rounds.fix: Aggregate application metadata notifications in FlushUpdates while retaining each changed ID, immediate direct updates and generation checks.

verification.workload: 5 active application IDs x 6 events in one frame
coverage: all five final names and statuses retained

rounds.scope: UI list and tooltip binding costs
rounds.finding: ShowGroup fully reset the tooltip before RenderGroup reset it again at the final width.
rounds.fix: Capture the owner without resetting; RenderGroup performs the one complete reset at the final width.

rounds.scope: Notes storage, query, reminder and import/export costs
rounds.finding: Merge normalized both long text fields before checking timestamps, discarding all that work for duplicate or older records.
rounds.fix: Trim reason and class/spec text only in the accepted-write branch; preserve identity validation, timestamp precedence and notifications.

verification.workload: One same-timestamp and one older import, both text fields >4KiB

rounds.scope: Floating, font and minimap hot paths and timer ownership
rounds.finding: Recruiting scroll rebinds called RefreshClock, walking every member/footer entry for application deadlines that cannot exist in this mode.
rounds.fix: RefreshClock skips recruiting; existing ShowPanel ownership continues cancelling the application ticker when switching modes.

verification.workload: Read-only fixture: 100 batches, 300 members, 400 entries, 12 visible-range changes
coverage: normal application deadlines and idle ticker cleanup

rounds.scope: Catalog, roster, relations, applicants and history refresh chains
rounds.finding: No additional actionable performance defect confirmed. Catalog invalidation is event-driven, relation snapshots are shared within the frame, roster/applicant notifications are coalesced, and history sampling stops with the active run.
rounds.fix: No code change; retained full data and existing business timing.

verification.method: Read-only review of current sources and existing regression coverage; no repeated full test run.
coverage: Relations index ownership and GetVersion callers
Applicants synchronous actions and deferred display

rounds.scope: Own runtime code: internal dead functions, state fields and branches
rounds.finding: Settings assigned settingsSwitch to each toggle, but no runtime, library, test or probe read it.
rounds.fix: Removed the unused assignment; retained the three existing visual callbacks, public facades and probe interfaces.

verification.method: Whole-repository reference scan and existing settings/UI regressions

rounds.scope: Localized text, UI remnants and own runtime media references
rounds.finding: 59 obsolete UI locale keys had no static or dynamic consumers; both language strings were still built when UI loaded.
rounds.fix: Removed only the unused locale entries. Preserved page/sort/state keys, library text keys and dynamically selected media.

coverage: zhCN and enUS paths in existing tests
Runtime media references including dynamic favorites/fonts checked

rounds.scope: Current documentation status, source contracts, entry links and historical evidence boundaries
rounds.finding: Top-level status conflated earlier audits/live installs with the current unpublished work, Product still described released 1.0.4 features as unpublished, and Architecture listed an unused catalog API plus an obsolete absolute no-load claim for settings.
rounds.fix: Updated four current status introductions against release 1.0.5; kept historical evidence unchanged; documented active-run history enablement and actual activity-group derivation.

verification.method: Eight formal Markdown documents' local link targets resolved; source/commit/changelog cross-check; git diff --check passed. No runtime test needed for documentation.

rounds.finding: No new actionable packaging or repository-boundary issue confirmed.
rounds.fix: No code change; retained automatic Bindings.xml, runtime licenses, historical releases and user/local artifacts.

coverage: Source and embedded library content match
Runtime files tracked; generated/local files ignored

rounds.scope: Offline test entry, shared fixtures and diagnostic documentation
rounds.finding: Unknown test module names were silently ignored; a typo ran zero tests and exited successfully, and mixed valid/unknown names hid the mistake.
rounds.fix: Validate the finite module list once before loading fixtures; unknown names report available modules and exit 2. Documented targeted selection in both READMEs.

rounds.scope: Core/context creation, theme ownership, embedding/version publication and API documentation
rounds.finding: No new actionable defect confirmed. Version publication follows the complete manifest, contexts own independent top-level state, and shared read-only color tokens follow the documented contract.
rounds.fix: No code change; retained existing public APIs and embedding lifecycle.

verification.method: Read-only source/API/README review against existing embedding and context regression coverage
coverage: No native allocation at definition load

rounds.scope: NativeFrame/Input/Button ownership, nested release and callback handoff contracts
rounds.finding: Focus callbacks could recursively release the same lease or move its host while Release kept stale ownership. Input and native-button handlers continued styling after callbacks released their lease, relighting an old field or restarting motion on a hidden context.
rounds.fix: Finish reentrant release once, recheck ownership after focus callbacks, and stop stale input/button visual continuation. Document callback transfer semantics; source compatibility revision is 19 with display version 1.2.0.

verification.workload: Existing native input/button stubs and original callback paths
coverage: Native text and normal restoration remain intact

rounds.scope: Menu/Choice ownership, availability and public close/hover callbacks
rounds.finding: OpenMenu continued after onMenuClosed changed ownership or hid the context/anchor. A reentrant longer menu left extra keys and caused nil indexing when overwritten by a shorter request; disabled Choice callbacks could reopen interactive menus.
rounds.fix: Recheck menu ownership, context/anchor visibility and Choice availability after close callbacks; give callback-opened menus precedence; document the public lifecycle.

coverage: 3-item callback menu replaces 1-item request without stale keys
Normal close and hover lifecycle retained

rounds.scope: Motion task replacement, cancellation endpoints and zero-duration API contracts
rounds.finding: Stop left Reveal placement endpoints behind, so a later StopAll overwrote caller positioning. Alpha/Reveal with zero duration divided by zero. Restarting the same key and callback function during Tick was mistaken for the completing old run.
rounds.fix: Discard cancelled placements, immediately finish zero-duration Alpha/Reveal, and track each Start identity through the reusable tick snapshot. Document cancellation and callback replacement semantics.

coverage: Cancel Reveal then manually position and StopAll
Zero Reveal has finite coordinates and no job
Same-function restart survives until next tick
Existing five-segment brand trajectory and clock regression coverage

rounds.scope: Component public callbacks, lifecycle and API decoupling
rounds.finding: A commit-on-release slider installed its frame sampler after onPreview had cancelled the drag or hidden the control; the next frame dereferenced a released drag.
rounds.fix: Stop Begin after the preview callback releases drag ownership; document callback cancellation. Normal drag geometry, step behavior and commit timing remain unchanged.

coverage: No stale OnUpdate after cancellation or reopen
Existing normal track/thumb drag and release cases

rounds.scope: Virtual list scroll scheduling and row release work
rounds.finding: Wheel input at either boundary or on a fully visible list scheduled a 140ms zero-distance animation. Row release also called CloseMenuFor twice through the same contract.
rounds.fix: Use the immediate refresh path when target equals current position; retain selection and hit-rect updates. Remove the duplicate menu close call.

verification.workload: One boundary wheel event followed by 14 x 10ms ticks; independent 120Hz probe also covered top/bottom/fitting lists
coverage: Cancel pending movement by returning to current offset
Existing partial row and recycled-click cases

rounds.scope: Menu opening, text measurement and bounded row binding
rounds.finding: Explicit menu width discarded the natural width result but still measured every label through native text APIs.
rounds.fix: Only measure natural label width when no explicit width is supplied; preserve scale clamping, item keys, viewport and selection.

verification.workload: 100-item menu with width=216, then automatic width
coverage: Automatic width still measures all 100 labels
Existing scale, edge placement, row reuse and long label checks

rounds.scope: Native lease acquisition, style refresh, restoration and object reuse
rounds.finding: No new actionable performance defect confirmed. Presentation snapshots are acquired per lease, updates follow focus/layout events, and reusable native button panels and scrollbar art are retained; there is no polling.
rounds.fix: No code change. Retained focus-triggered restyling because native or other-addon presentation may change between leases.

verification.method: Read-only review of Native.lua and actual product AcquireSearch/AcquireCreation callers against already-passing native suite
coverage: Removal of scripts and input registry on release

rounds.finding: No new actionable performance defect confirmed. Panels already coalesce unchanged geometry and composed color/alpha writes; shadows are static slices, text updates are cached, and five-person rosters use fixed objects and bounded scans.
rounds.fix: No code change; retained native geometry and public region behavior instead of adding speculative caches.

rounds.finding: No further actionable performance defect confirmed after architecture-4 cleanup. One driver runs only while jobs exist, snapshots are reused and cleared, initial native clock reads stop after first ticks, and shared brand coefficients are already precomputed.
rounds.fix: No code change; preserved all motion timing, curves and reduced-motion behavior.

120 steady frames without extra clock reads

limits: Offline widget-tree equality does not establish native pixel rendering or hardware interaction equivalence.
Runtime checks covered the named programmatic paths only; no real application/listing/invite/note-save action, active challenge or complete scaling matrix was tested.
The initial r19 probe's coordinate assertion failure is retained with exact before/after engine values; no product defect was found in that path.
No new addon-specific CPU/memory budget measurement was performed; the historical 20 MB high-frequency-list target remains unresolved.
